Accomplishment
1. Founder and teacher of the Mandarin Chinese Language Program in Bellaire Senior High School (HISD) Houston TX. 1975-2007

2. Mandarin Chinese instructor for the Albuquerque Teacher Training Workshop of the International Baccalaureate North America (北美洲國際課程教師研習營) 1994

3. Founding member and teacher of the Houston Taiwanese School of Languages and Culture (休士頓台灣語文學校) 1985-2005

4. Three essay collections published (湖山一片雲；往事知多少；與風水幾度相逢)。Many articles published in Taiwanese American newspapers, newsletters and magazines.

5. Publications collected by the Kaohsiung Literature Encyclopedia (高雄文學小百科) 2010

6. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 03/2019
